hook: Cosoreanu spent nearly two decades rising through GE's energy technology divisions, engineering, program management, and eventually product and CTO roles in grid automation, before taking the CTO seat at GE Vernova as the company builds the grid infrastructure and automation technology the energy transition depends on.
name: Claudia Cosoreanu

quote.text: Innovation without customer focus means that engineers get to have fun, but it does not mean that they are solving real problems. Co-creation and collaboration with the end customer is as important as being creative.
